signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the account your administrator created for you.
signIn.tooMany: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
signIn.unreachable: The server is unreachable. Check the connection and try again.
signIn.demoHint: Demo mode. Demo accounts are created by the seed command and shown once in its console output.

status.title: Status
status.expiresHint: A session ends after a fixed period; you then sign in again.
status.error: The API did not respond. Check that the service is running, then retry.

profile.title: Profile and preferences
profile.saveFailed: Could not save to your account. The choice applies on this device only.
profile.accessibilityIntro: How the interface supports different ways of working.
profile.accKeyboard: Every control can be reached and used with the keyboard; focus is always visible.
profile.accContrast: Text and controls meet WCAG AA contrast in both themes, and colour is never the only cue.
profile.accMotion: Animation is limited to short state changes and is switched off when your system asks for reduced motion.
profile.accLanguage: The interface is available in English and Hindi.

about.title: About and data notice
about.data1: Sensor models are calibrated from open research datasets and published specifications; all scenarios are authored or procedurally generated.
about.data2: No real operational or classified data is used. No claim of validated training effectiveness or doctrine accuracy is made; any effectiveness result will come only from our own measured pilot.
about.scope1: Defensive training only: recognise, classify, respond. The platform contains no instructions for building, arming or operating attack drones and no real-world targeting detail.
about.scope2: Rules of engagement are a fictional, editable rule set.
about.affiliation: This is an independent student project. It has no official affiliation with the Ministry of Defence, the Defence Services Staff College, DRDO, the Indian armed forces or any government programme.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: No page exists at this address.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: Your account role does not include this page.

offline.title: Server unreachable
offline.body: The application could not reach its server. Check the network connection, then retry.

module.body: This module is not built yet. It will appear here when that wave is delivered.

banner.reconnecting: Connection lost. Reconnecting, attempt {{attempt}}. The picture is frozen and inputs are held until the link returns.
banner.closed: The connection closed (code {{code}}). Inputs are not sent.

notSignedIn.title: Not signed in
notSignedIn.body: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again, then reopen the session.

forbidden.title: Session not available to you
forbidden.body: This session belongs to another account, or your role cannot play sessions.

notFound.title: Session not found
notFound.body: There is no session with this address. Create one from the Session lobby.

superseded.title: Opened in another window
superseded.body: The same account opened this session elsewhere. Only the newest window stays connected.

full.title: Server is full
full.body: The server is running its maximum number of live sessions. Try again shortly.

tooLarge.title: Message too large
tooLarge.body: The server refused a message as too large and closed the link (code {{code}}).

closed.title: Connection closed
closed.body: The link to the session closed (code {{code}}) before it opened.

end.title: End the session?
end.body: The session ends now and its event log is stored and verified. You cannot resume it.

eo.title: EO view · {{sensor}}
eo.summary: EO sensor {{sensor}}: bearing {{bearing}} degrees, elevation {{elevation}} degrees, field of view {{fov}} degrees, status {{health}}.
eo.noSensor: No EO sensor in this scenario
eo.noSensorBody: The briefing lists no electro-optical sensor, so there is no camera view.
eo.noWebglBody: This browser cannot create a WebGL context. The radar, track table and decision panel still work; the EO picture is not drawn.

ppi.title: Radar PPI
ppi.aria: Radar plan position indicator, range {{range}} kilometres. Tracks are listed in the track table.

legend.title: Identity symbols
legend.note: A track is unknown until you assess it. Dashed outline: tentative. Bar: coasting.

table.title: Track table
table.caption: Tracks held by the tracker
table.heading: Hdg
table.legend: Reference data: parameters not yet verified; figures are not measurements.
table.emptyBody: Tracks appear here once the radar has confirmed a contact.

detail.title: Selected track
detail.noneBody: Press Tab to select the first track, or click one in the track table.

decision.title: Decision panel
decision.noTrackBody: Press Tab to select a track, then C to classify, A to assess, R to respond.
decision.readyBody: C classify · A assess · R respond · H hold fire · U cue EO onto the track.
decision.hint: 1–9 choose · Enter commit · Esc cancel · ? shortcuts
decision.dropConfirm: Drop track {{track}}? The tracker may start a new one on the next plot.

preview.indicative: Indicative, from what you have set. The server checks the rule pack when you commit.
preview.noRule: No rule in the pack permits {{action}}.
preview.holdDefault: Hold fire is the default action. No rule is needed and it is always allowed.

verdict.title: Rules verdict
verdict.noneBody: A response is checked against {{pack}} when you commit it. The rule and its version appear here.

reason.default-hold: Hold fire is the default action; no rule is needed.
reason.no-rule: No rule in this pack permits {{action}}.
reason.conditions: The closest rule applies only when these conditions hold, and they do not.
reason.effector: The closest rule does not list {{effector}}. Allowed: {{allowed}}.
reason.authority: The closest rule needs {{authority}} authority. This session has none.

event.trackCoast: Track {{track}} is coasting: no recent update.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.cycle: Select the next or previous track. At either end the key moves focus on, so you never get stuck.
keys.choose: Choose an option in the open step
keys.cancel: Cancel the step; with nothing open, return to the workspace
keys.hold: Hold fire on the selected track
keys.cue: Cue the EO sensor onto the selected track
keys.merge: Mark the selected track, then press again on a second track to merge
keys.drop: Drop the selected track (asks to confirm)
keys.note: Space is not used in this build. Every action is also available with the mouse.

relabel.title: Relabel track {{track}}
relabel.label: New label
relabel.exchange: Take the label from another track if it is in use (they swap)

ended.title: Session ended
ended.error: The event log could not be read
ended.errorBody: The server did not return the stored log. Check the connection and try again.
ended.head: Chain head
ended.failed: Event log failed verification at sequence {{seq}}
ended.note: Scoring and debrief are not part of this build.

lobby.title: Session lobby
lobby.briefingLater: The full briefing (site, sensors, filed flights) is shown when the session opens.
lobby.errorBody: Check the connection and that the service is running, then retry.
lobby.emptyBody: The server lists no playable scenario. Ask your administrator to load a scenario pack.
lobby.createNote: You open the session next and begin it from the workspace.
lobby.createFailed: The session could not be created: {{detail}}
lobby.createForbidden: Your account cannot create sessions. Administrators cannot play.
lobby.createUnreachable: The server is unreachable. Check the connection and try again.

kit.missing: Not available; the EO view will not draw
